notes.title: Marketplace
notes.content:
In preparation for the next Dog Pack that will bring the game F2P, a market place has been added.
It will be possible to buy the dog with the [Spider Blood] from the marketplace.

As a reminder, for whom that already bought the game, you can immediately do the quest and get the dog for free once the pack is available.

notes.title: Many minor updates
notes.content:
Many minor updates including :
- The possibility to turn on/off the lightning effect in the options
- Possibility to adjust the brightness depending on your monitor setting in adv. options.
- Added different block chances on the melee weapons (Right Click)
- The knife has the least block chance but raised the offensive dmg
- Fix a graphic glitch on the arms
- Spell correction
- fix minor bugs

notes.title: *** IMPORTANT ***
notes.content:
This update comes with an important announcement.
There's a new DLC in the works.  This DLC will be the third for this game.
Once the DLC is launched, the game will go "Free to Play"
For all of you who already bought the game, it will be important to open the game after the patch, and complete a very easy quest, that will provide you with a permanent item.
This quest item will allow you to tame the merchant dog (Rex) for free, once the DLC is out in Fall 2022.
Rex brings an all new dimension to the game.
He warns you of incoming spiders, attacks your enemies and can even find hidden objects.
To start the quest immediately, go meet Rex, in the merchant area.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Reduced the difficulty / Improved the gameplay
notes.content:
Improved the overall experience by reducing :

- The number of enemies
- The number of spiders
- The enemies hit points, besides the last boss.

Eliminating the respawn of zombies in the sewers, once you've looted the gate key.  So you now can travel freely to complete the quest

Eliminating the need to consume an apple to free up an inventory slot, for a new apple if you aren't full health

Improving the visibility of the breakables, for loots

The compass is now given at the lighthouse, no need to find it

Added more hints

notes.title: Sit / Regen ability
notes.content: In addition to consume apples to heal yourself, you can now sit to regen your health to make you journey on the Island, easier.

notes.title: Combat system upgrade
notes.content: Many changes have been made in the combat system including new animations, different style of swing with their own strength and weakness.  You can now power up your main swing to do lots more damage.  The smaller hits are very useful in some situation.  I've also readjust the avoidance on the enemies, it was probably a bit to high.  But again, once you collect some playing cards, the enemies get really easy to hit.
